header: Panels that sort readers by how they buy
subheader: Each panel names who it is for and where it leads.
lead: All panels get the same weight on purpose. If a panel has a link, the whole card is clickable and the title names the link.
note: The note states what is true on every route, such as the price.

paths.title: Self-serve
paths.description: For readers who would rather start than talk.

paths.title: Talk to sales
paths.description: For readers who want to talk to a person before deciding.

paths.title: Through a partner
paths.description: For readers who already buy through someone else.
